These comparisons answer important questions about our design choices – specifically is it sufficient to simply to just use the REF component or to just learn the cost returns alone? pecifically is it sufficient to simply to just use the REF component or to just learn the cost returns alone? From this ablation study, we propose that though we have provided theoretical support for adding each of these design components individually, in practice they are both required together in our algorithm. This highlights the problems of the reachability function again – if the agent starts or ever wanders into the infeasible set, there is no guarantee of (re)entrance into the feasible set.
